# TypeScript API reference

## Factories and setup

### `createServerWallet`

Create a single-identity attested server wallet (ideal for one Cloudflare Durable Object per
wallet, or hosts managing per-identity storage and execution directly).

```typescript
export declare function createServerWallet(options: ServerWalletOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval?: "two-phase";
    readonly swaps?: undefined;
}): ServerWalletBase<"two-phase">;
export declare function createServerWallet<TFacet>(options: ServerWalletOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval?: "two-phase";
    readonly swaps: SwapsConfig<"wallet", TFacet>;
}): ServerWalletBase<"two-phase"> & {
    readonly swaps: TFacet;
};
export declare function createServerWallet(options: ServerWalletOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval: "allow-immediate";
    readonly swaps?: undefined;
}): ServerWalletBase<"allow-immediate">;
export declare function createServerWallet<TFacet>(options: ServerWalletOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval: "allow-immediate";
    readonly swaps: SwapsConfig<"wallet", TFacet>;
}): ServerWalletBase<"allow-immediate"> & {
    readonly swaps: TFacet;
};
```

### `createServerWalletService`

Create a multi-tenant server wallet service for backends operating many identities.
Computes canonical identity namespaces from the routed WaaS origin, project, issuer, audience,
and subject.

```typescript
export declare function createServerWalletService(options: ServerWalletServiceOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval?: "two-phase";
    readonly swaps?: undefined;
}): ServerWalletService<"two-phase", undefined>;
export declare function createServerWalletService<TFacet>(options: ServerWalletServiceOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval?: "two-phase";
    readonly swaps: SwapsConfig<"service", TFacet>;
}): ServerWalletService<"two-phase", SwapsConfig<"service", TFacet>>;
export declare function createServerWalletService(options: ServerWalletServiceOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval: "allow-immediate";
    readonly swaps?: undefined;
}): ServerWalletService<"allow-immediate", undefined>;
export declare function createServerWalletService<TFacet>(options: ServerWalletServiceOptionsBase & {
    readonly approval: "allow-immediate";
    readonly swaps: SwapsConfig<"service", TFacet>;
}): ServerWalletService<"allow-immediate", SwapsConfig<"service", TFacet>>;
```

### `ServerWalletOptions`

Options for `createServerWallet`.

```typescript
export type ServerWalletOptions<TApproval extends ApprovalMode = "two-phase", TSwaps extends SwapsConfig<"wallet", unknown> | undefined = undefined> = ServerWalletOptionsBase & (TApproval extends "allow-immediate" ? {
    readonly approval: "allow-immediate";
} : {
    readonly approval?: "two-phase";
}) & (TSwaps extends SwapsConfig<"wallet", unknown> ? {
    readonly swaps: TSwaps;
} : {
    readonly swaps?: undefined;
});
```

### `ApprovalMode`

Approval policy for transaction entrypoints:

- `'two-phase'` (default): only `prepare*` and `execute` exist; `send*` shortcuts are omitted at
  both type and runtime level.
- `'allow-immediate'`: additionally exposes one-shot `send*` methods for pre-authorized flows.

```typescript
export type ApprovalMode = "two-phase" | "allow-immediate";
```

### `SwapsConfig`

Opaque swaps provider configuration returned by `trails(...)` from
`@polygonlabs/oms-server-wallet-sdk/trails`. Pass to `createServerWallet({ ..., swaps })`
or `createServerWalletService({ ..., swaps })`.

```typescript
export interface SwapsConfig<TScope extends "wallet" | "service" = "wallet" | "service", TFacet = unknown> {
}
```

### `ServerWallet`

Single-identity server wallet handle, with `swaps` present only when `swaps: trails(...)` is configured.

```typescript
export type ServerWallet<TApproval extends ApprovalMode = "two-phase", TSwaps extends SwapsConfig<"wallet", unknown> | undefined = undefined> = TSwaps extends SwapsConfig<"wallet", infer TFacet> ? ServerWalletBase<TApproval> & {
    readonly swaps: TFacet;
} : ServerWalletBase<TApproval>;
```

## Storage and concurrency

### `createSingleProcessExecutor`

Create an in-process `ExclusiveExecutor` for a single Node process or one per-wallet Durable
Object instance. Clustered multi-process deployments must supply a distributed coordinator.

```typescript
export declare function createSingleProcessExecutor(): ExclusiveExecutor;
```

### `createSingleProcessExecutorPool`

Create an in-process per-namespace `ExecutorProvider` for a single Node process.
Reuses one queue per active namespace and reclaims an entry only once no owner or queued work
remains for that namespace. Clustered deployments must supply a distributed coordinator.

```typescript
export declare function createSingleProcessExecutorPool(): ExecutorProvider;
```

### `ExclusiveExecutor`

Cross-instance exclusive ownership boundary for one wallet identity.
`run` must hold exclusive ownership for the entire async task, including remote I/O.

```typescript
export interface ExclusiveExecutor {
    run<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
}
```

### `ExecutorProvider`

Provider that returns the `ExclusiveExecutor` for an SDK-computed identity namespace.

```typescript
export type ExecutorProvider = (namespace: string) => ExclusiveExecutor;
```

### `StateStore`

Durable key-value storage scoped to a single wallet identity.
Implementations must complete durable persistence before `write` resolves.

```typescript
export interface StateStore {
    read(key: string): Promise<string | null>;
    write(key: string, value: string): Promise<void>;
}
```

### `NamespacedStateStore`

Durable key-value storage partitioned by an SDK-computed identity namespace.
Implementations must isolate records by `namespace` and finish persistence before `write` resolves.

```typescript
export interface NamespacedStateStore {
    read(namespace: string, key: string): Promise<string | null>;
    write(namespace: string, key: string, value: string): Promise<void>;
}
```

### `WalletStoreOption`

Storage configuration for a single server wallet.
Choose either `{ adapter, encryptionKey }` (SDK-managed AES-256-GCM bound to this wallet's
namespace) or `{ encryptedStore }` (caller-managed authenticated encryption, isolation, and
durability).

```typescript
export type WalletStoreOption = {
    readonly adapter: StateStore;
    readonly encryptionKey: string;
    readonly encryptedStore?: never;
} | {
    readonly encryptedStore: StateStore;
    readonly adapter?: never;
    readonly encryptionKey?: never;
};
```

### `ServiceStorageOption`

Storage configuration for a multi-tenant server wallet service.
Choose either `{ adapter, encryptionKey }` (SDK-managed AES-256-GCM bound per computed
namespace) or `{ encryptedStore }` (caller-managed authenticated encryption, isolation, and
durability).

```typescript
export type ServiceStorageOption = {
    readonly adapter: NamespacedStateStore;
    readonly encryptionKey: string;
    readonly encryptedStore?: never;
} | {
    readonly encryptedStore: NamespacedStateStore;
    readonly adapter?: never;
    readonly encryptionKey?: never;
};
```

## EVM

### `EvmFacet`

EVM operations. `sendTransfer` and `sendCall` exist only with `approval: 'allow-immediate'`.
Flattened so declaration emit never needs the internal building-block interfaces.

```typescript
export type EvmFacet<TApproval extends ApprovalMode = "two-phase"> = {
    [K in keyof (TApproval extends "allow-immediate" ? {
        prepareTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        prepareCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        execute(input: ExecuteInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signMessage(input: EvmSignMessageInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signTypedData(input: EvmSignTypedDataInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        getOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        refreshOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        waitForOperation(id: string, options: WaitForOperationOptions): Promise<WaitResult<EvmOperation>>;
        resolveReconciliation(input: ResolveReconciliationInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        listOperations(options?: ListOperationsOptions): Promise<OperationPage<EvmOperation>>;
    } & {
        sendTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        sendCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
    } : {
        prepareTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        prepareCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        execute(input: ExecuteInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signMessage(input: EvmSignMessageInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signTypedData(input: EvmSignTypedDataInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        getOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        refreshOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        waitForOperation(id: string, options: WaitForOperationOptions): Promise<WaitResult<EvmOperation>>;
        resolveReconciliation(input: ResolveReconciliationInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        listOperations(options?: ListOperationsOptions): Promise<OperationPage<EvmOperation>>;
    })]: (TApproval extends "allow-immediate" ? {
        prepareTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        prepareCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        execute(input: ExecuteInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signMessage(input: EvmSignMessageInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signTypedData(input: EvmSignTypedDataInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        getOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        refreshOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        waitForOperation(id: string, options: WaitForOperationOptions): Promise<WaitResult<EvmOperation>>;
        resolveReconciliation(input: ResolveReconciliationInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        listOperations(options?: ListOperationsOptions): Promise<OperationPage<EvmOperation>>;
    } & {
        sendTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        sendCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
    } : {
        prepareTransfer(input: EvmTransferInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        prepareCall<const abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>>(input: EvmCallInput<abi, functionName>): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        execute(input: ExecuteInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signMessage(input: EvmSignMessageInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        signTypedData(input: EvmSignTypedDataInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        getOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        refreshOperation(id: string): Promise<EvmOperation | null>;
        waitForOperation(id: string, options: WaitForOperationOptions): Promise<WaitResult<EvmOperation>>;
        resolveReconciliation(input: ResolveReconciliationInput): Promise<EvmOperation>;
        listOperations(options?: ListOperationsOptions): Promise<OperationPage<EvmOperation>>;
    })[K];
};
```

### `EvmTransferInput`

### `EvmTransfer`

Normalized EVM native or ERC-20 transfer details.

```typescript
export interface EvmTransfer {
    readonly chainId: number;
    readonly to: string;
    readonly asset: "native" | string;
    readonly amount: string;

```

### `EvmCallInput`

Single EVM contract call input: either a typed ABI + function name + arguments (encoded with
viem) or pre-encoded hex `data`.

```typescript
export type EvmCallInput<abi extends Abi | readonly unknown[] = Abi, functionName extends ContractFunctionName<abi> = ContractFunctionName<abi>, args = ContractFunctionArgs<abi, AbiStateMutability, functionName>> = {
    readonly idempotencyKey: string;
    readonly chainId: number;
    readonly to: string;
    readonly value?: string;
} & (({
    readonly abi: abi;
    readonly functionName: functionName;
    readonly data?: never;
} & (readonly [
] extends args ? {
    readonly args?: args;
} : {
    readonly args: args;
})) | {
    readonly data: Hex;
    readonly abi?: never;
    readonly functionName?: never;
    readonly args?: never;
});
```

Input to `wallet.evm.signMessage`.

}
```

}
```

### `EvmOperation`

Persisted EVM operation view.

```typescript
export interface EvmOperation extends OperationBase {
    readonly family: "evm";
    readonly kind: "transfer" | "call" | "sign" | "signTypedData";

    readonly transaction?: {
        readonly to: string;

    };

}
```

        prepareTransfer(input: SolanaTransferInput): Promise<SolanaOperation>;
        execute(input: ExecuteInput): Promise<SolanaOperation>;
        signMessage(input: SolanaSignMessageInput): Promise<SolanaOperation>;
        getOperation(id: string): Promise<SolanaOperation | null>;

```typescript
export interface TronAbiArg {
    readonly type: string;
    readonly value: unknown;
}
```

### `TronSignMessageInput`

Input to `wallet.tron.signMessage`.

```typescript
export interface TronSignMessageInput {
    readonly idempotencyKey: string;
    readonly message: string;
}
```

### `TronSignTypedDataInput`

Input to `wallet.tron.signTypedData`.

```typescript
export interface TronSignTypedDataInput {
    readonly idempotencyKey: string;
    readonly network: TronNetwork;
    readonly typedData: TypedDataInput;
}
```

### `TronOperation`

Persisted Tron operation view.

```typescript
export interface TronOperation extends OperationBase {
    readonly family: "tron";
    readonly kind: "transaction" | "contractCall" | "sign" | "signTypedData";
    readonly network?: TronNetwork;
    readonly transaction?: {
        readonly to: string;
        readonly value: string;
        readonly data?: `0x${string}`;
    };
    readonly call?: {
        readonly contract: string;
        readonly method: string;
        readonly args?: readonly TronAbiArg[];
    };
    readonly maxFee?: string;
    readonly quote?: ChainQuote;
    readonly fee?: FeeOption;
}
```

### `ChainQuote`

Solana or Tron transaction quote returned by WaaS.

```typescript
export interface ChainQuote extends Quote {
    readonly feeOptions: readonly FeeOption[];
}
```

### `FeeOption`

Single fee option offered by WaaS for a non-sponsored chain transaction.

```typescript
export interface FeeOption {
    readonly token: {
        readonly network: string;
        readonly name: string;
        readonly symbol: string;
        readonly type: string;
        readonly decimals?: number;
        readonly contractAddress?: string;
        readonly tokenID?: string;
    };
    readonly value: string;
    readonly displayValue: string;
}
```

## Execution, observation and guidance

### `ExecuteInput`

Input to `execute` on any wallet family.

```typescript
export interface ExecuteInput {
    readonly idempotencyKey: string;
    readonly reviewId: string;
}
```

### `ResolveReconciliationInput`

Input to `resolveReconciliation` on any wallet family after an operator has independently
verified that an operation in `unknown` / `RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED` was never broadcast.

```typescript
export interface ResolveReconciliationInput {
    readonly idempotencyKey: string;
    readonly txnId: string;
    readonly resolution: "not-broadcast";
}
```

### `TypedDataInput`

Bounded EIP-712 (EVM) or TIP-712 (Tron) payload accepted by `signTypedData`.

```typescript
export interface TypedDataInput {
    readonly domain: TypedDataDomain;
    readonly types: Readonly<Record<string, readonly TypedDataField[]>>;
    readonly primaryType: string;
    readonly message: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}
```

### `TypedDataDomain`

Typed EIP-712 / TIP-712 domain binding the chain and verifying contract.

```typescript
export interface TypedDataDomain {
    readonly name?: string;
    readonly version?: string;
    readonly chainId: number | string;
    readonly verifyingContract: string;
    readonly salt?: `0x${string}`;
}
```

### `TypedDataField`

Single typed-data struct field definition.

```typescript
export interface TypedDataField {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly type: string;
}
```

### `OperationBase`

Shared public fields on every persisted operation across EVM, Solana, and Tron.

```typescript
export interface OperationBase {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly inputHash: string;
    readonly createdAt: string;
    readonly status: OperationStatus;
    readonly submissionMode: SubmissionMode;
    readonly reviewId?: string;
    readonly provenUnsent: boolean;
    readonly operatorResolved?: true;
    readonly signature?: string;
    readonly verified?: true;
    readonly txnHash?: string;
    readonly error?: WalletErrorCode | string;
}
```

### `OperationStatus`

```typescript
export type OperationStatus = "preparing" | "quoted" | "submitting" | "pending" | "executed" | "failed" | "unknown" | "signed" | "expired";
```

### `SubmissionMode`

```typescript
export type SubmissionMode = "review" | "immediate";
```

### `WalletOperation`

Union of all public wallet operation types across families.

```typescript
export type WalletOperation = EvmOperation | SolanaOperation | TronOperation;
```

### `ListOperationsOptions`

Options for paginated local operation listing.

```typescript
export interface ListOperationsOptions {
    readonly status?: "open" | "all";
    readonly limit?: number;
    readonly cursor?: string;
}
```

### `OperationPage`

One page of persisted operations.

```typescript
export interface OperationPage<TOperation extends WalletOperation> {
    readonly items: readonly TOperation[];
    readonly nextCursor?: string;
}
```

### `WaitForOperationOptions`

Options for `waitForOperation`.

```typescript
export interface WaitForOperationOptions {
    readonly timeoutMs: number;
    readonly pollIntervalMs?: number;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}
```

### `WaitResult`

Outcome of `waitForOperation`, keeping timeout/cancel distinct from transaction failure.

```typescript
export type WaitResult<TOperation extends WalletOperation> = {
    readonly outcome: "settled";
    readonly operation: TOperation;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "reconciliation-required";
    readonly operation: TOperation;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "timed-out";
    readonly operation: TOperation;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "cancelled";
    readonly operation: TOperation;
};
```

### `describeOperation`

Pure decision helper derived from validated operation evidence (never mutates state or calls the
network). Tells orchestrators and agents what is safe to do next, with original IDs.

```typescript
export declare function describeOperation(operation: WalletOperation): OperationGuidance;
```

### `OperationGuidance`

Pure derived decision guidance for orchestrators and agents.

```typescript
export interface OperationGuidance {
    readonly action: OperationNextAction;
    readonly reason: string;
    readonly operationId: string;
    readonly txnId?: string;
    readonly txnHash?: string;
    readonly reviewId?: string;
}
```

### `OperationNextAction`

Derived next-action classification returned by `describeOperation`.

```typescript
export type OperationNextAction = "await-review" | "poll-original" | "reconcile-original" | "safe-to-reprepare" | "done";
```

## Indexer (unattested)

### `WalletIndexerFacet`

Unattested indexer reads bound to this wallet's initialized addresses.

```typescript
export interface WalletIndexerFacet {
    getEvmBalances(options?: GetEvmBalancesOptions): Promise<EvmBalances>;
    getSolanaBalances(options?: GetSolanaBalancesOptions): Promise<ChainBalances>;
    getTronBalances(options?: GetTronBalancesOptions): Promise<ChainBalances>;
}
```

### `ServiceIndexerFacet`

Unattested indexer reads for arbitrary addresses on a wallet service.

```typescript
export interface ServiceIndexerFacet {
    getEvmBalances(address: string, options?: GetEvmBalancesOptions): Promise<EvmBalances>;
    getSolanaBalances(address: string, options?: GetSolanaBalancesOptions): Promise<ChainBalances>;
    getTronBalances(address: string, options?: GetTronBalancesOptions): Promise<ChainBalances>;
}
```

### `GetEvmBalancesOptions`

```typescript
export interface GetEvmBalancesOptions {
    readonly chainIds?: readonly number[];
    readonly page?: number;
}
```

### `GetSolanaBalancesOptions`

```typescript
export interface GetSolanaBalancesOptions {
    readonly networks?: readonly SolanaNetwork[];
}
```

### `GetTronBalancesOptions`

```typescript
export interface GetTronBalancesOptions {
    readonly networks?: readonly TronNetwork[];
}
```

### `EvmBalances`

Paginated EVM balances from the unattested indexer.

```typescript
export interface EvmBalances {
    readonly items: readonly EvmBalance[];
    readonly errors: readonly {
        readonly chainId: number;
        readonly message: string;
    }[];
    readonly nextPage?: number;
    readonly fetchedAt: string;
}
```

### `EvmBalance`

Single EVM native or ERC-20 balance from the unattested indexer.

```typescript
export interface EvmBalance {
    readonly chainId: number;
    readonly asset: string;
    readonly name: string;
    readonly symbol: string;
    readonly balance: string;
    readonly decimals?: number;
    readonly balanceUSD?: string;
}
```

### `ChainBalances`

Solana or Tron balances from the unattested indexer.

```typescript
export interface ChainBalances {
    readonly items: readonly ChainBalance[];
    readonly errors: readonly {
        readonly network: string;
        readonly message: string;
    }[];
    readonly fetchedAt: string;
}
```

### `ChainBalance`

A Solana or Tron balance. `asset` is `'native'` or the token's mint or contract address.

```typescript
export interface ChainBalance {
    readonly network: string;
    readonly asset: "native" | string;
    readonly name: string;
    readonly symbol: string;
    readonly balance: string;
    readonly decimals: number;
    readonly balanceUSD?: string;
    readonly tokenProgram?: "spl-token" | "token-2022";
}
```

## Errors

### `WalletError`

Structured SDK error exposing a safe code, message, and HTTP-oriented status.

```typescript
export declare class WalletError extends Error {
    readonly code: WalletErrorCode;
    readonly status: number;
    constructor(code: WalletErrorCode, message: string, status?: number);
}
```

### `UpstreamError`

Verified upstream WaaS RPC error with its numeric error code and RPC method name.

```typescript
export declare class UpstreamError extends WalletError {
    readonly upstreamCode: number;
    readonly method: string;
    constructor(upstreamCode: number, method: string);
}
```

### `isWalletError`

Type guard for `WalletError` (including `UpstreamError` and `TrailsError`).

```typescript
export declare function isWalletError(error: unknown): error is WalletError;
```

### `isUpstreamError`

Type guard for verified WaaS RPC `UpstreamError` instances.

```typescript
export declare function isUpstreamError(error: unknown): error is UpstreamError;
```

### `WalletErrorCode`

Closed union of safe, machine-readable SDK error codes.

```typescript
export type WalletErrorCode = "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" | "ATTESTATION_FAILED" | "CHAIN_READ_FAILED" | "CONFIGURATION" | "CREATION_UNCERTAIN" | "DEBIT_PENDING" | "EXECUTE_REFUSED" | "FEE_ABOVE_QUOTE" | "FEE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED" | "FUNDING_FAILED" | "FUNDING_RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED" | "FUNDING_REVERTED" | "FUNDING_UNKNOWN" | "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT" | "IDENTITY_MISMATCH" | "INDEXER_UNAVAILABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE" | "INTENT_ALREADY_TRACKED" | "INTENT_NOT_FUNDABLE" | "INVALID_ADDRESS" | "INVALID_AMOUNT" | "INVALID_CALL" | "INVALID_FAMILY" | "INVALID_FEE" | "INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" | "INVALID_IDENTITY" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "INVALID_JSON" | "INVALID_MESSAGE" | "INVALID_METHOD" | "INVALID_PAGE" | "INVALID_RECOVERY" | "INVALID_RECOVERY_TRANSACTION" | "INVALID_RESPONSE" | "INVALID_STATE" | "INVALID_SWAP" | "INVALID_SWAP_QUOTE" | "INVALID_TRANSACTION" | "INVALID_TRANSFER" | "INVALID_TYPED_DATA" | "NO_CREDENTIAL" | "NO_RECOVERABLE_BALANCE" | "NOT_FOUND" | "PREPARATION_FAILED" | "QUOTE_EXPIRED" | "RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED" | "RECOVERY_CHANGED" | "RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_PENDING" | "RECOVERY_EXPIRED" | "RECOVERY_FAILED" | "RECOVERY_LIMIT" | "RECOVERY_NOT_READY" | "RECOVERY_PENDING" | "REFUND_REQUIRES_REVIEW" | "RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE" | "RPC_CONFIGURATION" | "SETTLEMENT_REQUIRES_REVIEW" | "SIGNATURE_INVALID" | "SIGNING_FAILED" | "SPONSORSHIP_REQUIRED" | "STALE_QUOTE" | "STALE_RECOVERY" | "STALE_REVIEW" | "STORAGE_INTEGRITY" | "SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN" | "SWAP_ENVIRONMENT_CHANGED" | "SWAP_UNAVAILABLE" | "SWAPS_COORDINATION_REQUIRED" | "SWAPS_DISABLED" | "SWAPS_UNAVAILABLE" | "TRAILS_ABORTED" | "TRAILS_ERROR" | "TRAILS_TIMEOUT" | "TRAILS_UNAVAILABLE" | "UNSUPPORTED_BATCH" | "UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN" | "UNSUPPORTED_NETWORK" | "UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL" | "UPSTREAM_ERROR" | "UPSTREAM_REDIRECT" | "WALLET_BUSY" | "WALLET_DISABLED" | "WALLET_MISMATCH" | "WALLET_NOT_INITIALIZED" | "WALLET_PENDING";
```
